messages:
Maya: heads up — hit a weird typing/interop issue when using the JS SDK in an edge worker (Vite + Cloudflare). Generics collapse to any when I import the ESM build, but CJS local tests are fine.
Sam: can you paste the minimal repro + tsconfig?
Maya: sure, tiny snippet: 
```ts
const client = new RedwoodClient();
const r = await client.generate<{ user: string }>(prompt);
// r is typed as any in bundle, but OK in node test
```
Maya: tsconfig is basically default for Vite: { "target": "es2022", "module": "esnext", "moduleResolution": "bundler", "isolatedModules": true }
Liam: known footgun: isolatedModules + certain bundlers can drop type-only imports or transform overloads weirdly. Edge runtimes also sometimes expect .d.ts shape that matches the runtime export (named vs default).
Sam: also check if the SDK ships both ESM and CJS with different type entrypoints — that causes consumers to pick the wrong d.ts at bundle time.
Maya: yup found the package.json exports map pointing to ./dist/esm/index.js but types -> ./dist/cjs/index.d.ts (oops)
Maya: so Vite picks esm runtime but the types are for cjs shape which has different overloads.
Sam: that explains it. Solution: align types field with exports or provide separate path mappings.
Liam: another pain: unknown vs any in the SDK surface. We upgraded some generics to unknown, which is safer, but a few overloads rely on implicit any and bundlers infer any at consumer site.
Maya: concretely — auth middleware return type is AuthResult<unknown> in types, but runtime attaches props, so downstream callers often do `const x = await getAuth(); x.session` and TS can't narrow without casting.
Sam: we should provide overloads that let caller opt into concrete generic: `getAuth<T extends Session = unknown>(): Promise<AuthResult<T>>` and add examples in README for edge workers showing explicit generics.
Maya: also ran into retry helper mismatch: browser fetch retry signature differs from node fetch, and our auth/retry types don't reflect environment-specific overloads, so TS shows call-signature errors in the edge bundle.
Liam: Proposal: publish a small `sdk-edge-compat.md` with recommended tsconfig, vite config, and example augmentations. Short-term publish a patch aligning package.json types/export entries.
devex-bot: created issue RD-882: "ESM types mismatch + edge worker typing fallout" and linked a draft PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/742
Sam: I'll push a quick fix to exports + dts build to ensure types for both ESM and CJS are generated and mapped. Also add a test that bundles an edge worker sample and checks the emitted d.ts shape.
Maya: that would unblock our onboarding sample app. Thanks — will re-test once PR lands. :thumbsup:
